[[File:Ad_alexred.jpg|thumb|right|AlexRed]]
Founder of Angels of Death Moscow Quake clan.
Graduated from MIREA, work as a web designer.

Like: Drawing, Quake, light beer in large quantities, good friends, Gitanes Blondes cigarettes, dm6, rock music (from classic rock'n'roll to punk and metal), pieces of meat and the slurping sound of a quad missile hitting, and many other delights of real and virtual life.
A rather quarrelsome person, but nice. :)
